criteria_lexicographic: Is a one-line tombstone epitaph of famous last words, a single line of dying speech carved in stone
Earns a real laugh on one read, from a genuine joke rather than a mild pun or a sad sentiment
Turns on a surprise, a twist or a double meaning that lands cleanly
Reads like something carved on a stone: one short line, no stage directions, no explanation
Stays in the head after reading, quotable enough to repeat to a friend
